note: engine-kit/tools/game-build.mjs (distribution.md §6) — the ONLY build entry a game may document in game.json.buildEntry. Plain Node (node:* only — no new dependency). All paths from its own file location (import.meta.url) or explicit absolute arguments — never process.cwd().

steps.detail: kit root from import.meta.url; game dir from --game (absolute); derive data/build/template paths
re-hash the vendored tree against kit.json (lockfileDigest + kitDigest + per-file on any digest mismatch)
game.json.enginePin (engineVersion, kitDigest, lockfileDigest) vs the ACTUAL kit identity
npm ci --prefix <kit> (lockfile-authoritative; registry or warm cache)
steps.failure: kit_install_unavailable (structured — never a silent skip or partial install)

steps.detail: npm run build --prefix <kit> = check-deps → check-boundaries → typecheck → build.mjs (the accepted pipeline)
steps.failure: the pipeline step's own structured failure (boundary violation / forbidden runtime import / type error / build error) — no game output exists yet

steps.detail: verified copy of the kit templates/ set into <gameDataRoot>/templates/ (packet 65 identity)
spawn the kit backend deployment bundle (game data root; THIRDLIGHT_ENGINE_ROOT=<kit>; admin token; loopback bind — all tool-derived) and call the accepted admin export route
steps.failure: the accepted export error codes (content_quota_exceeded, content_publish_failed, …) unchanged

steps.detail: the static closure exists under <game>/build/<projectId>@r<revision>/ with its metadata (export.md §4 shape)
steps.failure: a structured export failure (the closure is absent or incomplete — never claimed built)

rules.rule: run from /, from the game root and from the checkout → identical verified outputs (no process.cwd() anywhere in the tool; the engine build.mjs is invoked only via npm run build, where npm fixes the working directory to the kit root)
rules.negative: a tool revision that reads process.cwd() for the kit root

rules.rule: any symlink whose realpath leaves the game directory is rejected at assembly AND re-checked before every build

no functional path reference to the original checkout in the kit's GENERATED data (kit.json, NOTICE, game.json) or in the tool source; the docs/contracts/** copies may RECORD evidence paths (byte-identical engine source — the CCR-66-1 exemption; digests still bind)
no credentials/tokens/origin literals in kit data or tool source (the export.md §5.4 forbidden-content class applied to kit data); NOTICE is REQUIRED

kit_path_rejected (a directory symlink into the original checkout is NOT independent — m4-plan §2.3 table)
